en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a small rural town with several notable buildings scattered among trees and fields. The landscape is slightly hilly, with a forested area at the horizon. There are a few large, multi-story houses, and a sign for a business is visible. The text on the image is in German, with red and black printing, and includes references to Sebnitz and the Saxon Switzerland (Sächsische Schweiz) region.
